notes.title: BIGBIA v1.20版本更新
notes.content:
BIA友们大家好，版本重做后游戏有很多问题，我们和很多玩家讨论了很多关于新版本的意见，大家的建议主要集中在：
内容不足，应该尽快补充上古版本的内容
完美破甲机制和身份卡需要合成人物的表达不明确
很多事件的体验不佳
BUG偏多
英文国际化缺失
我们正在优先解决以上问题，谢谢大家的支持和鼓励，我们正在加油。

[h2]1.20版本更新的主要内容[/h2]
[h3]主要模式的梳理[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/9da8583e67da314fc58b0a03e72b01bc9d3a2736.png[/img]
1.20更新后将加入3种主要模式：每日挑战、标准模式、无尽模式。他们不需要通过单图解锁，会直接出现在桌面上。
1.标准模式
类似上古版本的模式，在这个模式中去往三个不同的地点然后迎接最终boss。

2.每日挑战
根据每天不同的规则，使用随机的角色进行挑战，在每天更新的排行榜上脱颖而出，在这个模式中没有最终boss，也就意味着探险没有尽头，随着前进会面临越来越大的挑战。

3.无尽模式
在这个模式中，玩家可在地图中随意行走，地图会不时刷新，面对不同的挑战，看看自己能生存多久。冲击每月刷新的排行榜，这个模式处于BETA阶段，正在逐步完善中。

[h3]地图整合[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/94c7f167e5c53e7c0ca8cb385a5ecfeed1a687eb.png[/img]
这次我们把上古版本中的健身房、马戏团、网吧、虫巢、沙漠、雪地和画室整合了进来，1.20版本后12个地图在3个主要模式中将全部可用，并且优化了数值。

[h3]卡包系统整合[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/f03a45456fc237c94ac446d0626945d2b032a095.png[/img]
将卡包系统整合完毕，在开始探险前可以选择卡包进入，卡包选择的越多难度会有所增加，在之后的更新中这会让冒险获得更多奖励

卡片商店也加入了卡包
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/e67e660836113377e1b8a3b1b7610788dbd1b150.png[/img]

[h3]问题修复及游戏调整[/h3]
现在非完美破甲也会使怪物最大护甲-1
对部分特效进行了优化
现在开始冒险时，玩家会默认选择上次选择的身份卡。
现在在商店中能看到道具卡片的属性值提升数值
修复商店在打折情况下价格不正确的bug
修复电风扇无效的bug
修复巨熊昏迷是的不正常行为
修复禁忌显示不正常的bug
修复武侠修仙大战僵尸中击败僵尸王有概率游戏不结算的bug
修复Boss会使加速失效的bug
修复部分完美破甲时护甲结算不正确的bug
修复药水回复数值不正确的BUG以及在佩戴墨镜时依然可以回复生命的bug
修复肉鸽模式胜利时徽章不能正常结算的bug
修复主界面中上下移动的按钮显示不正常的bug
修复人鱼大招引发的bug
修改打工人的描述
修复孙悟空的bug
修复流浪狗攻击不正常的bug

notes.title: BIGBIA 1.0版本来了！
notes.content:
感谢大家一年多的耐心和陪伴，和我们一起走过了游戏的EA阶段。BIGBIA作为一个小众游戏，能有幸结识这么多朋友，真的很开心呢。感谢各位玩家的鼎立支持，我们花费了很多精力去打磨这款游戏，希望能为大家增添一些快乐。

[h3]1.0版本都有哪些变化：[/h3]

[h2]冒险如何运作？[/h2]

新版本的冒险是以你选择的地点和身份开始的，身份卡分为主角和配角,他们有自己的独特剧情和机制，你可以任意搭配他们。故事也会相应有一些变化。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/18202ae944812e22a4a66d3bccfc0340e17622e4.png[/img]

[h2]如何养成？[/h2]

应大家的广泛意见我们还是保留了吞噬道具的核心玩法，你在探险的过程中可以用人物卡去定义一张身份卡，也就是把他们合成在一起，让角色成为一个“完全体”，当他成为了“完全体”就可以用老版本的方式合成道具了。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/9041fc912d03fd8dc9d4307f00886e881285f422.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 吞噬道具的节奏维持了老版本的设定。
[*] 人物最高升级为金色，紫色时解锁终极技能。
[/list]


[h2]机会卡！[/h2]

现在的战斗中，不时出现神奇的“机会卡”，他为游戏带来了各种变化，让你的旅途充满惊喜。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/51151272ffd76e1f117e6b5fecaffb7c273a5c7f.png[/img]

[h2]新的元素机制[/h2]

在这个版本中，我们加入了风火水电四种元素，他们有自己独特的作用，有些还可以相互反应达到特殊的效果哦。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/ecd619aed1eb1d2f4242fefc4becd3e1cb4e1bda.png[/img]

[h2]徽章系统和卡片商店[/h2]

在你使用独特的地图+身份+人物赢得冒险后，就会解锁一份独特的徽章，收集徽章来获取奖励吧。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/20c87df3d397fc8e0970085d129bd4bfbc93ae6a.png[/img]

现在你可以用各种方式获得星星，从而在商店中购买新的卡片加入到游戏中

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/d130eb425185baf2f1495260d71ecd767e901068.png[/img]

[h2]类Rogue模式的进化[/h2]

现在你通过各种模式解锁的各种元素（地点、身份、随从、道具、机会）都会被加入到肉鸽模式之中，来一锅莫名其妙的大乱炖吧。这个模式目前内容还在逐步整合中，会慢慢完善起来。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/8cd5d8aca014f8b67fbc490311b2052a791b7685.png[/img]

[h2]之后如何更新[/h2]

这次版本更新之后，我们不会再花费大把时间改动游戏框架了，而是全力更新游戏的内容以及改进游戏对社区内容的支持！游戏刚刚重制完成，难免有一些不稳定的地方，我们会第一时间修复。谢谢大家，共创BIGBIA 的未来吧

[h3]向始终对游戏抱有热情的各位 致敬。[/h3]

notes.title: 我们决定在6月10日发布1.0版本
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/93fb28fc11969fc4bfb41375b14f57a9cc745566.png[/img]
[h2]我们决定在6月10日发布1.0版本。[/h2]

各位BIA友大家好，本应如约而至的的V0.9版本这个月并没有正式更新，因为在测试过程中我们发现0.9版本的数据可能和1.0版本存在诸多兼容问题，因此不得已在群内用试玩分支的形式以独立的存档放出，而在主分支上，我们决定跳过这个版本直接更新1.0版本，它将在6月10号到来。没有让大家第一时间体验到新的内容我们十分遗憾，希望大家能够理解。

BIGBIA自抢先体验以来，已经经历了一年多的时间，在这段时间内，我们尝试了这款游戏的各种可能性，其中有一些有趣的玩法被保留了下来，还有很多不尽人意的模块被忍痛割爱。这是一段开心的过程，因为让我们感受到和玩家们一起创造和见证一个游戏的成长是多么快乐。经过了这一年的努力，游戏的形态已经确立，我们想把1.0版本当作一个里程碑，在之后的时间全力更新有趣的新内容，而不再对游戏的玩法和机制进行大规模的修改。

由于游戏进行了重制，在1.0版本到来后，目前的版本将会被保留为独立的分支，大家可以随时切换。
希望有时间的玩家加入到我们的玩家群，与我们进行交流

notes.title: BIGBIA V0.9 is coming soon
notes.content:
I'm sorry we used machine translation，I know it's very difficult to read。

Dear BIA friends, it has been more than a year since the open experience of the game. During this period, we have made several major changes and gained valuable opinions from many friends. We deliberated the game a few months ago and decided to make the last major upgrade before the official version, solve the problems of the current game, absorb everyone's terrible suggestions, and release our own new inspiration.

The change project is so huge that we have to drill into the game to modify every screw. It is said that the outside world has entered a cold winter (I mean the price of graphics card). I am very worried and miss you.

First of all, we optimize the performance of the game, which also serves the scalability of the content.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/3be697e4b3a83989fc97894b45a57666638c34a2.png[/img]
Each plate is modular, and different game scenarios are assembled by different modules.

The new game process, players have to face different maps and gradually begin to explore the game. Each map has its plot, unique rules and special things. For different maps, you will enter them with different "identity cards". The identity card is not a specific character, but an "identity". For example, some maps, he will be a master and apprentice. Some maps will be the king and servant. Who needs you to make him synthesize the current character card? For example, synthesize the stray dog into the king. The king of this expedition is the stray dog king.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/c462102aaede4052ad2db11b697aa79f4b54dac1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/a6038d6446013015500944773fc17d44f2410062.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/7b187d7440af9f4ee56df1467a8b10de2d7ddaac.png[/img]

In the process of exploration, you can transform the map, and each experience and story are different.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/806ac64b38d1e5839343e9e7ee4249a83e3ed1c5.png[/img]

This is our highly experimental new mechanism. How it really works still needs you to experience the new version of the ship.

After the player completes the three maps, the rouge mode similar to the current version will be unlocked. The more elements you unlock, the more you will encounter things.

Previously, with more and more cards, the card pool will become larger and larger, which makes it difficult to gather routine cards. Therefore, we have added the concept of card bag. You can choose the card bag you want to bring at the beginning, including the cards in the creative workshop. The card package can be used in each map, combined with different identities to try various chemical reactions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/c397524d485284f2f0fc59e57e89407b0400eb89.png[/img]

The previous phagocytosis mechanism has greatly weakened the differentiation of followers, and the personality of the original follower card is not prominent. Now it is different, he said they not only have their own sources, but also become more powerful because of the new synthesis mechanism. Each follower can cultivate him into a hero and become a hero at the heart of your game.

Monster slots are also divided into yellow and blue. Sometimes you can make monsters stand in the wrong grid, so that their skills become invalid, and even make them rebel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/f8bb4357f74346482c6ab001e1b3d606d8af4d42.png[/img]

The hard step limit of torch has been removed. Instead, the longer you stay in the map, the more challenging the battle will be. This will be related to the new mechanism.

Brand new events: there were too few events before. Now we have greatly expanded the richness of events, and we have also made simple maps for them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/7841c415dd7059beb27bbeaa1540d99831732455.png[/img]

The contract level is removed and the contract is unlocked. You can choose to bring you richer rewards when starting a game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/253dfb009153d7ac51911dfb2d4ef67e9de62877.png[/img]

We also upgraded the UI to evolve from a super bad UI to a bad UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/67cdabf3cb2c5bf480d08e5b66bce2713b4bb439.png[/img]

Now the battle card can preview the contents
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/4fefe5573c9ce030883c2bd425bf37ca0b3c000a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/1b25811d67c817f9cad884a4b3741f7355e82ee8.png[/img]

We also added tutorials to make it easier for new players to get started
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/e52cc53a12a069eb19cc4d74d802adc1e6603759.png[/img]

The previous big newspapers ran aground due to extremely difficult internationalization. We are studying how to revive them.

In short, there are still some scattered wires that have not been connected. When we connect the last few solder joints, we can bring the new version to you. Don't forget to come to the group and put forward terrible suggestions.

Hello, everyone, BIA friends, I am Lao Gao. During this time, our studio is moving back to Beijing from Nanjing, but we can hardly catch up with COVID-19. Most of the members have been isolated. notes.title: 《宇宙大报刊》首刊发售 陪您探索挨打王不为人知的一面
notes.content:
[b]本社记者离奇失踪[/b]

                                              [b]采访记录疑点重重[/b]


                                           [b]【挨打王】卷入离奇凶案[/b]

                                            [b]拍扁之星疑为幕后真凶！[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/780ec8be4bd218dbdaa74eff4c10278c5826e446.jpg[/img]

据悉，在近期拍扁大魔王的征途中，以脸皮著称的挨打王凭借强壮的体魄，成功从众多候选英雄中脱颖而出，夺取了“真正的拍扁之星”称号。冒险团凯旋后，本社记者【李狗蛋】有幸获得了采访MVP挨打王的机会，一番畅谈拿到了许多不为人知的资料。怎奈资料还未传回，人却突然离奇失踪，似是人间蒸发……本社深度怀疑该无人知晓内幕的凶案与挨打王有关。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/6efe3812b94f2d0e6050d1f099b8d19e48662216.png[/img]

另，据本社了解，新晋偶像歌手【欧阳翠花】亦决定踏上拍扁大魔王的冒险，让我们期待立志用歌声击败大魔王的她，会有怎样优异的表现吧！



[h3]新添加[/h3]
宇宙大报刊首期（包含数个新的卡片、羁绊事件和性格）
扭蛋扭出的东西会显示在桌面上

[h3]调整[/h3]

notes.title: Big Bia EA version description
notes.content:
[h2]1. Combation of Nine different dungeons[/h2]
In addition tot he Forest, Circus and Volcano showed in the Demo version. EA version of the game added: Maple Forest, Desert, Game Company, Worm Nest, Internet Cafe, and Dungeon.
There will be multiple Exits generated in each map level. Players can choose which scene to enter in the next level according to their own situation. The total number of levels is adjusted to 4 with each level map being smaller. （Pictures shown are not final）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/917c8e6c806b0c2390440757aca42278c1f9b500.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/f5b4efb67324a2a57c8c263980b13cc589227303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/544f422e0ae75fb0eda2cd96e50ca94ce818ca2e.png[/img]

Three bosses are optimized to simplify the lengthy of the skill description and add a “Boss core” to the battle field to clarify the Boss attack intention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/59a620e0c036d26ba8d6583311de7a8867111e02.png[/img]

[h2]2. The story generation system and Flatten the boss with a “Bia”[/h2]
In the Ea version of the game, some interesting content will be generated and displayed in the adventure Log during the player’s journey. It will content the events and battles on the journey to make it more immersive and fun for players. However,  if players who do not like the story and events, they can choose to ignore it and it wont affect the flow of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/4321b03e6cdceb2dcbbd04145208d0e1feb74e33.png[/img]

After he player defeats the boss, the boss will appear on a tale, the player can find a favorite angle to flatten the boss and generate a painting, along with the adventure log, it will be permanently recorded on the Adventure Monument.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/e6100e07c0bef2f2cdb4cbf139a13790754720d2.png[/img]

[h2]3. Added special rooms to the map[/h2]
Added a variety of special rooms randomly appears in the map, some of the important ones are the blessing point. Where players can level up their hero, and the effects last until the end of the exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/d16769de0dbbd13f25ade972142221fbb39c3bc9.png[/img]

Other than that, Ruins, Alchemy room, Hospital, Bank and Recreation room will be gradually added during the progress, not all of which may be completed.

[h2]4. Added the Hero Room [/h2]
Hero’s room, which appeared int he main screen, will now be integrated into the EA version. Players will be able to adjust the abilities of each hero by changing the decoration of each hero’s room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/89c02248e3042ca7fa5aee71a428b3c4576aef9e.png[/img]

[h2]5. Integrate the Rune system after rework[/h2]
The rune system has been reworked and integrated into EA

[h2]6. Improved hero selection interface and added contract level[/h2]
The hero selection interface has been reworked and added new contract level. After complete a exploration you can challenge the higher difficulty for that hero.

[h2]7. Integrate the Gacha box[/h2]
The gacha box is now available, players can earn gacha ticket during the exploration. You can get New minions,Trinkets, Hero furniture,Voxel, Play Tips, etc from the gacha box

[h2]8.  New heroes, minions, and items[/h2]
New heroes, minions, and items will be added over time.

notes.title: Alpha1109 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. Starting from this update, we will release the announcement of STEAM at the request of players, so that you can see the update more clearly.

There haven’t been any major updates recently, as we have spent a lot of time exploring the possibilities of multiplayer mode, and we are currently opening up a very immature version of battling mode for everyone to try out. If you have good ideas for multiplayer gameplay, you can share it with us in the steam community.

This update includes:

Adjustment of game rules:
Minions have updated with range attribute.
Minions can only attack the first target in the same column.
Monsters will now have their own formations, and more synergy among them.
Monsters will no longer move forward each turn, but instead attack the hero directly when there is no target.
Added more higher level Minions to choose from, the further you explore, the higher your chance to meet them.(green and blue)

Content update:

9 new Minions
8 new Monsters
8 new Events

Other:

Adjust some value.
Fixed a lot of bugs.
Optimized display and animation play speed.

After this update, we will focus on the content and quality of the game, accelerate the pace of content updates, and gradually update the UI, Visual effects, player experience and other aspects.
